decisions.executionNote: Colors left-to-right are red, blue, green. Begin elbow-up lift and rotate left gripper above the left cover; right arm stays at origin.
Align the left gripper downward over the first cover and approach slowly, leaving final grasp depth for visual correction.
Close around the aligned first cover and lift vertically while keeping its orientation. Check RGB retention before moving over red.
The first cup is retained in RGB. Move it over the left red block, then lower vertically to cover it without changing orientation.
Set down and release the first cover over red. Lift clear, then approach the middle cover from the left workspace.
First red block remains covered. Align and descend onto the middle cup, keeping the left arm on its side of the centerline.
Close on the middle cover and lift vertically. Keep gripper closed and inspect retention before covering the middle blue block.
Middle cup is retained. Translate over blue and lower to cover the second block; red stays covered.
Release middle cover over blue and withdraw left. Begin symmetric elbow-up approach with right arm toward the third cover, keeping arms separated.
Continuity guard rejected left withdrawal, not a grasp step. Replan smaller left increments away from center while right completes its downward alignment above third cup.
Right gripper descends onto third cover, closes and starts a vertical test lift. Park left safely above covered red, without uncovering it yet.
Third cup is retained. Lift clear and move it over the right green block, then begin lowering. Red and blue remain covered.
Finish covering green third and release its cup. Then close on the left cup and start uncovering red first, leaving blue and green covered.
Lift and move the red cover to the front clear of its block. Prepare a stationary grasp on green, but do not lift it until red is visibly uncovered.
Red is uncovered. Set its cup down in front and release. Uncover green second with the right arm, moving its cup forward while blue remains covered.
Green is visibly uncovered second. Place its cover in front and withdraw right. Bring the left gripper above the remaining middle cover over blue.
Use smaller alignment increments after the guard, descend onto blue's cup and close. Right cup is released; begin a gradual elbow-up return of the right arm.
Uncover blue last by lifting its cup and carrying it forward. Red and green are exposed. Return the empty right arm smoothly toward its origin.
Set the final cup down upright in front of blue, release, and lift clear. Settle the right arm at origin; inspect all exposed blocks before returning left.
Final cup is released. Withdraw the empty left arm toward origin with gradual rotation, maintaining elbow-up continuity and clearance above the cups.
All three blocks are now exposed and cups remain upright in front. Complete the left arm's gradual return to its original pose and settle both open grippers.
